from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    from collections import defaultdict
    pts=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg: pts[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for color, ps in pts.items():
        if len(ps)<2: continue
        # Use aligned diagonal pairs as a direction cue, extending outward from both ends.
        pairs=[]
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(ps):
            for rr,cc in ps[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr!=0:
                    step=(dr//abs(dr),dc//abs(dc))
                    pairs.append(((r,c),(rr,cc),step))
        if not pairs: continue
        # Continue the established diagonal from its two endpoints, only through background.
        for (r,c),(rr,cc),(dr,dc) in pairs:
            for sr,sc,ar,ac in ((-dr,-dc,r,c),(dr,dc,rr,cc)):
                nr,nc=ar+sr,ac+sc
                while 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and out[nr][nc]==bg:
                    out[nr][nc]=color
                    nr+=sr; nc+=sc
    return out
'''
